Details
This table contains the names of doctors who were previously approved by the Maritime and Coastguard Agency (MCA) but whose approval has lapsed during the last two years, showing the date when they ceased to be approved.
Approval can lapse for a variety of reasons, including retirement, change of address, or no longer wishing to carry out ENG 1 examinations.
The table listing MCA previously approved doctors is correct as of the ‘last updated’ date.
